question.text: Provisional expenses of the fund that have NOT been written off can be treated as assets IF:

answer.text: They can be directly written off against the fund's capital

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1 asset list, provisional expenses are an asset only if they can be directly written off against the fund's capital. The Trap: Size, Trustee approval, audit alone don't confer asset status. Cross-Exam Context: Accounting convention aligned with Ind-AS. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Discuss provisional-expense treatment with fund accountant at each quarter-end.
